prompt: Create a production game VFX sprite sheet for MONSTER DEFENSE, a premium dark steel fortress cooperative RPG. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no mockup, no text, no letters, no UI labels, no character, no checkerboard baked into pixels. Exactly eight equal square cells, arranged four columns by two rows, read left to right top to bottom. Each cell depicts the SAME upright teleport gate centered at the SAME position, with its foot at 85 percent cell height. Consistent framing and scale, large empty transparent padding so the luminous effects do not touch cell edges. Elegant cyan-white spatial energy with a dark gunmetal segmented ground ring, tiny cool blue rune sparks, vertical wisps of luminous vapor. A dimensional doorway that could envelop a full-height soldier, elliptical ground perspective. The eight cells are an animation cycle: 1 small ground ignition, 2 widening floor ring with rising sparks, 3 portal rising halfway, 4 complete tall luminous gate, 5 strongest tall portal white-cyan central flare, 6 gate breaks into soft upward wisps, 7 dispersing fading sparks, 8 faint residual floor glow. Crisp detailed 2D game art, fine painterly lighting, spectacular but restrained enough not to hide the character or HUD. Strong coherent silhouette at small scale, soft alpha fade at all outer edges. Canvas aspect ratio 2:1, ideally 2048x1024. Strict evenly sized 4x2 sprite atlas, no drawn grid lines, no frames. This is for departure and arrival teleport effects while a squad member supports another defense lane.
